records.title: The Government Efficiency Framework
records.publisher: HM Treasury and Government Finance Function
records.locators: Sections 4.1–4.4, especially IT-system time-saving example; sections 4.8 and 6 for net costs and benefits governance
records.population_and_base: UK central-government efficiency reporting; not a survey; no respondent base
records.usable_point: Distinguishes spending reductions, time/capacity at unchanged spending, and non-monetisable benefits; cash claims need baseline, counterfactual and outturn evidence.
records.limitations: Adapt principles proportionately to private employers; do not call this payroll outcome evidence or apply government reporting rules as private-sector requirements.

records.title: The Green Book 2026
records.locators: Table 4 critical success factors; chapter 5 options including BAU and do-minimum; chapter 6 sensitivity and optimism bias; introduction proportionality
records.population_and_base: UK public-spending appraisal guidance; not survey data
records.usable_point: Value, affordability, supplier capability and achievability are separate tests; uncertainty and alternatives need explicit treatment.
records.limitations: Do not label a JGA adapted checklist an official Green Book method or imply all employers must use its formal process. Avoid arbitrary weighting and invented predictive scores.

records.title: 8 April 2026 Synergy Programme Summary Business Case
records.source_type: Original published prospective programme business case
records.locators: Executive summary; 2.2 shortlisted options; 2.3 comparative costs, benefits and sensitivity; 5.1–5.2 delivery model and critical path
records.population_and_base: One very large shared HR, finance, procurement and payroll programme for four departments and associated bodies; not a payroll-only sample
records.usable_point: A real approved case separates investment, running costs, cash and non-cash benefits, alternatives, sensitivity and delivery assumptions.
records.limitations: Modeled returns and future benefits are not realised outcomes; present no payroll-only unit costs or typical-employer benchmark.

records.title: Update on government shared services
records.locators: Printed summary paragraphs 7–9 and 22–23; PDF pages 9 and 13 respectively (one-based); printed paragraphs 1.18–1.23 on ownership, risk and dependencies
records.population_and_base: UK government five-cluster shared-services strategy; combined corporate functions; audit approach in appendix, not representative survey
records.usable_point: Progress and improvements coexist with unresolved ownership, interoperability and onboarding risks.
records.limitations: Do not narrate as a completed Synergy outcome evaluation. Copyright page restricts commercial reproduction; do not redistribute PDF or reproduce charts without rights review.

records.title: The Sourcing Playbook
records.locators: Delivery model assessment, whole-life cost, data/risk pricing, chapter 13 expiry extension transition and termination; PDF printed page 72 for exit planning
records.population_and_base: Public-service sourcing guidance; not payroll survey data
records.usable_point: Transition resources, incumbent data, contract-end timing and risk allocation can affect feasible alternatives and pricing.
records.limitations: Edition includes historical procurement-law references; use enduring practice principles only, not current legal advice or evidence of how common lock-in is.

records.title: PAYE and payroll for employers Choose how to run payroll
records.publication_or_update_date: Not displayed in reviewed extract; accessed 2026-10-28
records.population_and_base: UK PAYE employer responsibilities; not survey data
records.usable_point: Provider support varies and the employer retains responsibility for PAYE tasks.
records.limitations: Specific to the stated PAYE context; do not generalise across all global payroll or employment arrangements.

records.title: Payroll Emerges as a Priority for AI Enabled Operational Transformation
records.source_type: Research publisher public product and findings release
records.locators: Report scope and criteria paragraphs; end section offering registered summary and purchasing enquiry for full 82-page research
records.population_and_base: Release describes 18 providers and 26 criteria; customer interview number, geography and recruitment not shown in reviewed release
records.usable_point: Payroll provider assessment is an existing research product with both free-summary and full-report routes.
records.limitations: No JGA demand or price inference. Hold headline cost/automation statistics because full context and respondent bases were not inspected. Do not register or enquire autonomously.

records.title: Payroll Key Benchmarks
records.population_and_base: Describes cross-industry Open Standards Benchmarking in Payroll; numerical tables, respondent sample and timing not inspected
records.usable_point: Existing payroll benchmarking covers cost, cycle time, process efficiency and staff productivity.
records.limitations: No numeric benchmarks, pricing or rights claimed. Public product evidence only, not new payroll prevalence evidence.
